name: @cas/dynamics
description: Complex-dynamics domain package: exterior (inverse-Böttcher) Riemann maps of the z^d+c / polynomial / rational families — the Laurent coefficients that uniformize the complement of a filled Julia set (and of the multibrot connectedness locus), capacity, and boundary reconstruction. Extracted from Complex Dynamics on the ADR-0007 second-consumer rule (Riemann Map is the second consumer). Convention-neutral, on @cas/core + @cas/expr. Consumed via SOURCE by the suite's Vite/Vitest bundlers (no dist build).
author: Andrew Graven <andrew@graven.com>
